info.title: Jaha Digital API
info.description:
## Connection **Base URL:** `https://api.jahadigital.shop/v1`
**Authorization:** `Authorization: Bearer jaha_live_...`
**Swagger:** `https://api.jahadigital.shop/docs` Use only the documented `/v1/...` Public API routes shown below. Top up the account in the Telegram bot. Readable guides: [RU](https://api.jahadigital.shop/guide?lang=ru) · [EN](https://api.jahadigital.shop/guide?lang=en) · [中文](https://api.jahadigital.shop/guide?lang=zh) · [VI](https://api.jahadigital.shop/guide?lang=vi). ## Request limits * **120 reads/minute per API client**: one shared allowance for all authenticated account, catalog, product and order GET requests. * **10 purchases/minute per API client**: separate allowance for `POST /v1/orders`, including retries. * **60 invalid-key attempts/minute per IP**: this does not consume valid clients' allowances. Pagination, polling and catalog 304 responses also consume the read allowance. Limits use minute windows. On HTTP 429 wait for `Retry-After` seconds. ## Safe order creation and retries `POST /v1/orders` requires an `Idempotency-Key` of 8–128 characters. Generate one key for one purchase and store the exact request body with it. * After a timeout, `429`, `500`, `503`, or `request_in_progress`, retry the **same body with the same key**. For `429`, wait for `Retry-After` first. * After `insufficient_balance`, top up the shared Telegram balance, then retry the **same body with the same key**. * After `price_changed`, re-read the product. If the accepted price or price limit changes, send the changed body with a **new Idempotency-Key**. Do not retry a rejected price blindly. * Never send parallel retries for one purchase. A changed body with an old key returns `idempotency_conflict` instead of creating another order. Responses contain only the documented product and customer order fields. `GET /v1/products` keeps its legacy catalog for existing clients. New integrations should send `current_only=true` to exclude products removed from the current catalog. Products that are still current but temporarily have zero stock remain visible with `status=out_of_stock`. ## Order history `GET /v1/orders?limit=50&include_additions=true` returns `orders` and `next_cursor`. Only the authenticated client's API orders are included, not all Telegram or Mini App purchases. `limit` is 1–100, default 50. Pass a non-null `next_cursor` as `cursor` with the other parameters unchanged. Orders are newest-created first, not sorted by supplementary update time; cursor is not a changes feed. Re-read known older orders by number when waiting for further data. New orders also contain `terms_at_purchase`: a customer-facing immutable snapshot of the title, description, guarantee, period and delivery type shown when the purchase was created. Older orders can return null. ## Supplementary data on the same order An order marked `completed` can receive supplementary data later. Re-read `GET /v1/orders/{order_number}?include_additions=true`, or use `GET /v1/orders?include_additions=true` for a history page. The default is false: existing JSON keys/types and original delivery are unchanged. Opt-in `delivery` is cumulative original data plus all additions in creation-ID order, separated by two newlines without headers. Blocks are not additional purchased units. Reading does not change the order number, status, quantities or money; there is no new purchase or separate order number. Fulfillment can be explicitly confirmed with an addition or manually; ordinary additions alone do not imply completion. Provisional responses remain readable but are not fulfilled goods. GET headers X-Jaha-Order-Additions and X-Jaha-Additions-Included indicate available additions and whether they are included (page total for lists). While waiting, use GET, not POST or a new Idempotency-Key. Deduplicate per order using `updated_at` and delivery content; do not re-deliver the cumulative text on every read. Use a configurable polling interval with backoff and bounded attempts or a deadline; on HTTP 429 honor `Retry-After`. There is no promised supplement SLA, final-additions marker or webhook.

401.description: The bearer API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: API access or purchases are disabled for this client.

404.description: The requested product, order, or endpoint does not exist.

409.description: The order cannot be created in its current state, for example because of insufficient balance, changed price, stock, or idempotency state.

422.description: The request contains invalid or unsupported fields.

429.description: The client rate limit was exceeded; follow Retry-After.

500.description: Unexpected server error. Keep the request_id and contact support; never send the API key.

get.description: Cursor-paginated product catalog in the Telegram account language. Set current_only=true to exclude products removed from the current catalog without changing the legacy default. Products that require customer data describe it in buyer_input.

parameters.name: current_only

schema.description: Exclude products removed from the current catalog. The default remains false for backward compatibility.

parameters.description: Exclude products removed from the current catalog. The default remains false for backward compatibility.

schema.description: Opt in to page ETag / If-None-Match. Matching pages return 304; no JSON fields change.

post.description: Send one unique 8–128 character Idempotency-Key per purchase. Network, 429, 500, 503, request_in_progress, and insufficient_balance retries must reuse the exact same body and key. After price_changed, re-read the product; if the accepted price or price limit changes, use the changed body with a new Idempotency-Key. When buyer_input.required is true, submit the advertised fields before payment.

get.description: Cursor-paginated order history for the authenticated API client. Set include_additions=true for cumulative original delivery plus all same-order supplementary data. This does not change JSON fields, quantities, status or money, and creates no purchase. Completed orders may get later additions; deduplicate by updated_at/content and poll with configurable bounded backoff, honoring Retry-After on 429.

parameters.name: include_additions

schema.description: Append all same-order supplementary data to each order's delivery; default is unchanged.
